purpose: Primary NUTS after the completed paired covariance screen
initialization: Same four optimization starts as primary PMMH and the earlier NUTS run. New common proposal covariance from nuts-metric-check-v1. Fresh seeds and full warmup; no earlier warmup samples are pooled.
interpretation: Increasing particle count changes the estimator used by pseudo-marginal sampling, not its intended parameter posterior. The local diagnostic does not establish particle adequacy everywhere.
checks: Four independent chains; all18 Rhat<=1.01, bulk/tail ESS>=400, zero NUTS divergences; visual trace checks and prior/particle sensitivity. Completion alone is insufficient.
retention: Retire NUTS3262256/create1792113782.16 only after a finite first replacement checkpoint and verified source/target metadata. Preserve old warmup/termination record. PMMH processes remain unchanged.
timing: Count original start/metric preparation, the PMMH pilot used to construct the covariance, all retired NUTS warmup, both depth/metric screens, and replacement warmup in setup costs. Shared-GPU screen is not production ESS/sec.
comparison: Same target, prior, J10000 and G1000 as primary PMMH/NUTS. Covariance and initial step size changed after a completed paired screen. This does not change the prior.
review: First finite checkpoint/source-target validation before retiring old NUTS; movement/acceptance review after50 warmup, then all18 posterior diagnostics after retained sampling.
tuning_decision: Candidate covariance with doubled frozen steps passed all prespecified gates: movement-rate ratio3.013, paired95% interval[1.696,6.128], trajectory acceptance.622, zero divergences, no coordinate point losses. Use a common initial step.07, rounded from the geometric mean of the tested per-chain doubled steps (.0573--.0884); existing warmup adapts each chain separately. Local evidence only.
